name: audio-analyzer
description: Give Claude the ability to hear music. Analyzes audio files for key, tempo, dynamics, timbre, and structure — all from raw DSP, no images, no guessing.
long_description:
Audio Analyzer runs real audio analysis — the same DSP techniques used in music information retrieval research — and returns structured numerical data that Claude can reason about. Point Claude at any audio file (mp3, wav, flac, ogg, aac) and it can tell you the key, tempo, dynamics, timbre, and how the music evolves over time. Full analysis of a 60-second track completes in ~150-230ms. Pure Rust, no external dependencies.

Features:
- Spectral analysis: brightness, richness, rolloff, tonality
- Temporal features: loudness (RMS), texture (zero crossing rate)
- Timbre: 13 MFCCs (Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients)
- Harmonic analysis: key detection, pitch class distribution, tonnetz
- Rhythm analysis: tempo estimation, beat tracking, onset detection
- Time-series data: track how every feature evolves over time at selectable resolution

tools.name: audio_info
tools.description: Get basic audio file info: duration, sample rate, sample count

tools.name: spectral_features
tools.description: Analyze spectral and temporal features: brightness, richness, loudness, texture, timbre (MFCCs)

tools.name: harmonic_analysis
tools.description: Analyze harmonic content: key detection, pitch class distribution, tonnetz

tools.name: rhythm_analysis
tools.description: Analyze rhythm: tempo (BPM), beat positions, onset detection, tempo stability

tools.name: full_analysis
tools.description: Run all analyses in one call: spectral, harmonic, rhythm, and temporal features
